title: Asserts that explain

milestone.title: Visual Studio and the Build Pipeline

description:
Write an assert macro that prints the expression, a message, the file and the line.

```
ASSERT(hp >= 0, "health went negative")
-> Assertion failed: hp >= 0 (health went negative)
   at main.cpp:14 in applyDamage
```
hints: `#cond` turns the condition into a string, so the message shows the code that failed (lesson 4.02).
In Visual Studio, `__debugbreak()` stops in the debugger instead of ending the program.
requirements: In debug builds it prints and stops (`std::abort`); with `NDEBUG` it does nothing at all.
stretch: Add `VERIFY(cond)`, which still runs the condition in release builds.
